title: What Does an LLM-Agent Leaderboard Rank Actually Compare?
abstract: arXiv:2609.07785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An LLM-agent leaderboard invites a familiar inference: an agent ranked above another is the better agent. Public evaluation logs may not support that conclusion when systems differ in task mixture, label source, release detail, or cost rule. We study what leaderboard scores estimate and when they justify pairwise superiority conclusions. Our estimand-aware pairwise procedure states the comparison target and measurement source, checks common support, and evaluates the supported difference using a stated uncertainty rule and practical margin. Controlled checks evaluate the decision labels under known finite-sample conditions and show why uncertainty must be included when judging sensitivity to target reweighting. Across SWE-bench, AgentRewardBench, and tau2-bench, close rank differences are often unresolved; proxy labels and utility rules can also change which system is selected. translated_title: LLM智能体排行榜的排名究竟在比较什么？
translated_abstract: LLM智能体排行榜容易让人得出一个熟悉的推断：排名高于另一个智能体的就是更好的智能体。然而，当各个系统在任务组合、标签来源、发布细节或成本规则上存在差异时，公开的评估日志可能无法支持这一结论。我们研究了排行榜分数究竟估计的是什么，以及它们何时能够支持两两优劣结论。我们提出的考虑估计目标的成对比较程序明确了比较目标和测量来源，检查了共同支撑域，并使用明确定义的不确定性规则和实用边际来评估可支持的差异。受控检验在已知的有限样本条件下评估决策标签，并说明了在判断对目标重加权的敏感性时为何必须纳入不确定性。在SWE-bench、AgentRewardBench和tau2-bench上的实验表明，接近的排名差异往往无法被判定；代理标签和效用规则也可能改变最终被选中的系统。DataAgentBench和Open Agent展示了哪些内容仍然可以被估计。
tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑估计目标的成对比较程序，揭示LLM智能体排行榜上接近的排名差异往往无法确定优劣，且代理标签和效用规则的选择可能改变最终胜出的系统。
